pins.title: New Year's Day? Start it on a trail.
pins.sub: How to find a First Day Hike near you.
pins.pinTitle: First Day Hikes 2027: how to find a New Year's Day hike near you and what to bring
pins.description: First Day Hikes are guided and self-guided walks that state parks hold on January 1. Find your state's list in December, register early if the hike needs it, and dress in layers with shoes that grip. Our guide covers what to wear, what to bring and what happens in bad weather.

pins.title: First day in Rocky? Go slow up high.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: First-day hikes in Rocky Mountain National Park: easy walks while you get used to the altitude
pins.description: Rocky Mountain National Park is high country: most trailheads sit between 8,000 and 9,500 ft (2,400 to 2,900 m), so even fit hikers feel it on day one. Our 30-page printable planner suggests easy first-day walks, explains the warning signs, timed entry and 18 day hikes. Instant PDF download. Check nps.gov/romo for next season.

pins.title: Rocky Mountain lakes, planned early
pins.sub: Timed entry, best hikes, sample days.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Rocky Mountain National Park trip planner: timed entry, Bear Lake hikes and 1, 2 and 3-day plans
pins.description: Planning Rocky Mountain National Park for next summer? This printable guide explains timed entry step by step, the Bear Lake Road hikes to Nymph, Dream and Emerald Lakes, Alberta Falls and Mills Lake, plus sample 1, 2 and 3-day plans and a packing list. Instant PDF, US Letter and A4. Check nps.gov/romo for your dates.

pins.title: Packed snow turns to ice fast
pins.sub: Shorter steps, and know when to add traction.
pins.pinTitle: How to hike on icy trails: walking tips and when you need microspikes
pins.description: Winter trails that look like soft snow are often packed into ice by midday. Take short, flat-footed steps, slow down on descents, use trekking poles, and add traction that slips over your boots when the trail is icy. Our guide explains when you need microspikes and when to turn around.

pins.title: Windy ridge? Pull it over your nose.
